admin.title: Wasseruhr-CV · Admin
admin.empty.title: No model yet
admin.empty.text: Import an existing model (ZIP) below under “Back up & transfer”, or teach camera images with the correct meter reading on the training page until every digit 0–9 has been learned once. If your camera sits differently from the default, set the ROIs first.
admin.auto.title: Auto-reading
admin.auto.text: Reads the camera image regularly and writes only certain, plausible values to Home Assistant: forward only, and no faster than water can flow.
admin.auto.camera_label: Select camera – the preview shows whether it is the right one
admin.auto.set_label: Set the meter reading by hand, e.g. after replacing the meter or if “lower than the previous reading” is reported permanently
admin.training.title: Training
admin.training.upload_label: Learn your own image with a known meter reading
admin.readings.title: Recent readings
admin.readings.text: The last 20 since start. The number opens the reading on the training page.
admin.templates.title: Templates
admin.templates.text: This is how the matcher sees each learned digit. If a tile does not fit its row, it comes from a wrongly learned image: tap the tile, then correct or delete the training image below.
admin.images.title: Training images
admin.images.text: Newest first, showing the counter. If a value is wrong, correct or delete it. With learning on, the templates are rebuilt right away.
admin.backup.title: Back up & transfer
admin.backup.text: The model consists of all training images and templates. It is also part of every Home Assistant backup of the add-on. An export can be moved back and forth between the add-on and Docker.
admin.backup.import_label: Import model: an export from the admin page or a ZIP of the data folder
